intro: We hold a recorded main-programme fee of up to ₹{{budget}} lakh for {{count}} published LLB colleges in India. This list of the best LLB colleges under ₹{{budget}} lakh is a fee filter for three-year LLB programmes in our records.

Central University of Haryana is listed first, with LLB at ₹10,900–₹15,000. Kakatiya University's Department of Law and Central University of Kashmir follow, also with low public-university fees that may be annual.
Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh have the most listings. LAWCET is the most commonly recorded test, though many colleges are untagged.
listLead: These are the top LLB colleges in India 2026 with a recorded main-programme fee of up to ₹1 lakh. Public university departments sit near the top; private universities such as RKDF and ITM Gwalior appear next.
snapshot: Across {{feeN}} published colleges with a recorded fee, the median total is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.
{{private}} colleges are private, {{public}} are public, and a few have no ownership type. Bhopal, Ahmedabad and Jaipur are the leading cities on this list.
A CAT tag appears once in our exam counts, which is unusual for LLB and should be verified on the official admission page before you rely on it.
firstCollegesLead: Jitendra Chauhan College of Law, Mumbai, is listed as public, with LL.B. at ₹28,112. Confirm the official fee for the current year, including university and enrolment charges.
Department of Law, Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda, is listed at ₹25,680, with a 2023 average package of ₹3 lakh. That package is historical and may not be published for every LLB batch.

sections.heading: Three-year LLB fees versus integrated law
paragraphs: This article is for the three-year LLB list. If you want a five-year BA LLB after Class 12, use the integrated law fee article instead.
A public-university LLB fee close to ₹11,000 may be one year's tuition. Add the remaining years only from the official notice.

compare.heading: How to compare the best LLB colleges under ₹1 lakh
paragraphs: A central university LLB and a private university LLB can share this cap and still differ in eligibility, because the three-year LLB usually needs a prior bachelor's degree.
bullets: Whether the recorded fee is annual or for the full three years, plus exam and bar enrolment charges.
The eligibility rule for the three-year LLB, including the required bachelor's degree.
The admission test, such as LAWCET, MH CET Law, or a university process.
Bar Council of India approval and the official university affiliation.

faqs.question: How many LLB colleges in India have fees under ₹1 lakh here?
faqs.answer: We list {{published}} published LLB colleges with a recorded main-programme fee up to ₹{{budget}} lakh. Colleges without a usable fee on file are excluded.

faqs.question: What is a typical LLB fee on this list?
faqs.answer: The median recorded total is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half falls between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}. Confirm whether the official notice is annual or for three years.

faqs.question: Is this list for the five-year BA LLB?
faqs.answer: No. This page is the three-year LLB fee list. The five-year integrated law fee list is a separate article, and the eligibility rules are different.

faqs.question: Why are the first public-university fees close to ₹11,000?
faqs.answer: Central University of Haryana is listed at ₹10,900–₹15,000, and Kakatiya University at ₹11,447. Those figures may be annual. Check the official circular before you budget for three years.

faqs.question: Is this a ranking of the best LLB colleges under ₹1 lakh?
faqs.answer: No. It is a fee filter. Approval, eligibility and the official fee notice should guide the shortlist.
